name: M7 relation projection: bounded graph query vs pure Evidence RAG (30 fixtures, 34 cases)
notes: Three independent relation chains plus distractor and filler documents. Every fixture is short-line markdown, so each non-blank line becomes one child chunk and the corpus is ~133 chunks; production RAG returns at most top_k=8 of them.

Relations are annotated with deterministic [[subject|predicate|object]] triples; the optional fourth field declares aliases for the subject. Questions are natural language and never contain the expected answer entity.

ragStrictHit means every alignedEvidence marker appears in a returned chunk whose documentId is the expectedDocument, and no forbiddenEvidence phrase appears in any returned chunk. ragLooseHit (marker anywhere) is reported only as a diagnostic.

graphHit means every expected node is present, no forbidden node is present, and the shortest hop from the seed equals expectedHops when declared. Unknown-seed negatives require an empty graph with an active snapshot; depth-bound negatives require the forbidden node to stay outside the queried depth.
The set is still directional rather than statistically powered, but the case-count guard in the harness prevents a keep/simplify recommendation on fewer than 10 multi-hop cases.

# Acme procurement
Acme supplies turbine blades to Beta Corp under a five-year contract.
The contract covers the northern assembly programme and includes scheduled audits.
Deliveries are tracked against quarterly volume targets.
[[Acme|supplies|Beta Corp]]

# Beta operations
Beta Corp operates the Gamma Plant assembly site in the northern district.
The site runs two shifts and reports output weekly.
Safety reviews are completed at the start of each quarter.
[[Beta Corp|operates|Gamma Plant]]

# Gamma cooling
The Gamma Plant draws coolant from the Delta Reservoir pipeline.
Cooling water is tested every morning before the first shift.
Intake readings are logged for the environmental audit.
[[Gamma Plant|draws_coolant_from|Delta Reservoir]]

# Delta Reservoir
Delta Reservoir is maintained by the Epsilon Water Authority.
The reservoir serves the northern industrial corridor.
Water levels are published on a public dashboard.
[[Delta Reservoir|maintained_by|Epsilon Water Authority]]

# Epsilon Water Authority
Epsilon Water Authority reports to the Zeta Regional Board.
The authority publishes an annual water quality report.
Inspection findings are shared with industrial users.
[[Epsilon Water Authority|reports_to|Zeta Regional Board]]

# Zeta Regional Board
The Zeta Regional Board meets quarterly in Theta City.
Board meetings review infrastructure spending.
Minutes are published after each session.
[[Zeta Regional Board|meets_in|Theta City]]

# Theta City
Theta City hosts the Regional Command Center.
The city coordinates emergency planning for the region.
Municipal services publish a monthly readiness bulletin.
[[Theta City|hosts|Regional Command Center]]

# Northwind shipping
Northwind ships precision components to Contoso.
Shipments leave the eastern depot every Tuesday.
Each consignment is sealed and scanned at dispatch.
[[Northwind|ships|Contoso]]

# Contoso assembly
Contoso assembles the Orion Device for the navigation market.
The device is assembled from incoming precision components.
Assembly lines are audited twice a year.
[[Contoso|assembles|Orion Device]]

# Orion Device
The Orion Device uses Halcyon Alloy in its guidance housing.
Navigation units ship with redundant sensors.
Field returns are tracked by serial number.
[[Orion Device|uses|Halcyon Alloy]]

# Halcyon foundry
Halcyon Alloy is produced at the Vantage Port foundry.
The foundry casts housings for precision instruments.
Casting batches are traceable to source lots.
[[Halcyon Alloy|produced_at|Vantage Port]]

# Vantage Port
Vantage Port handles two outbound carriers, Kestrel Rail and Mira Basin.
Port capacity is reviewed each quarter.
Berth schedules are coordinated with regional freight operators.
[[Vantage Port|handles|Kestrel Rail]]
[[Vantage Port|handles|Mira Basin]]

# Kestrel Rail
Kestrel Rail delivers finished housings to Ostra Holding.
Rail service departs the port twice daily.
Freight manifests are filed before departure.
[[Kestrel Rail|delivers_to|Ostra Holding]]

# Mira Basin
Mira Basin is maintained by Ostra Holding under a port services agreement.
The basin supports bulk carriers and storage barges.
Dredging is scheduled outside peak shipping periods.
[[Mira Basin|maintained_by|Ostra Holding]]

# Verdant Labs
Verdant Labs develops the Serum X candidate.
The programme focuses on early-stage metabolic disease.
Laboratory results are reviewed by an independent panel.
[[Verdant Labs|develops|Serum X|Verdant;Verdant Laboratories]]

# Serum X
Serum X is evaluated in Trial 7 under an adaptive protocol.
Dosing schedules are reviewed monthly.
Participants are monitored for twelve weeks.
[[Serum X|evaluated_in|Trial 7]]

# Trial 7
Trial 7 is reviewed by two regulators, Regulator A and Regulator B.
The trial enrolled adults across three sites.
Safety data is submitted after each review cycle.
[[Trial 7|regulated_by|Regulator A]]
[[Trial 7|regulated_by|Regulator B]]

# Regulator A
Regulator A reports to the Health Directorate.
The regulator publishes inspection findings.
Compliance notices are issued after site visits.
[[Regulator A|reports_to|Health Directorate]]

# Regulator B
Regulator B reports to the Oversight Committee.
The regulator reviews trial safety data quarterly.
Findings are shared with participating sites.
[[Regulator B|reports_to|Oversight Committee]]

# Health Directorate
The Health Directorate publishes annual trial safety notices.
Notices are distributed to participating sites.

# Oversight Committee
The Oversight Committee reviews regulator findings quarterly.
Findings feed into the annual assurance report.

# Regional logistics bulletin
Beta Corp and Gamma Plant appear in a shipment delay notice.
The notice concerns Delta Storage, a separate warehouse.
No production schedule changes were announced.

# Northern works review
Acme and Northwind attended the supplier fair.
Orion Router demonstrations drew crowds.
The review covers regional sourcing trends.

# Halcyon Logistics
Halcyon Logistics operates warehouses near Vantage Port.
The operator handles general freight only.
Its services are separate from alloy production.

# Gamma planning office
Gamma Planners advise on site scheduling.
The office has no role at the assembly site.
A monthly planning note is circulated internally.

# Zeta Regional Counsel
Zeta Regional Counsel provides legal advice to the board.
The counsel does not set meeting locations.
Its engagement is reviewed each year.

# Facilities handbook
Badge access is required after hours.
Meeting rooms can be booked through the front desk.

# Travel policy
Travel bookings require manager approval.
Expense reports are due within ten days.

# Data retention
Operational logs are retained for ninety days.
Retention exceptions require written approval.

# Vendor onboarding
New vendors complete a security questionnaire.
Contract review follows the questionnaire.
